_comment: Copy to applicant.json and fill in. That file is gitignored — it holds passport-level data and must never be committed.
_foreignerIdNumber_note: YKN / 99-prefixed ID, if you already have one. Leave empty on a first application.
_phone_note: With country code, e.g. +90 5xx xxx xx xx
_supporterName_note: Who covers your costs — yourself, a parent, a scholarship body

documents._passport_note: Absolute path to the scan of your passport photo page
documents._addressProof_note: Rental contract / dormitory letter / address registration
documents._previousPermit_note: Existing İkamet card — extension applications only

_residenceCardSerialNo_note: NOT auto-filled — the letter prefix on the card is entered by the applicant themselves.
_residenceCardNo_note: Document/Card No on your current İkamet card — the digits after the prefix. Extensions only.
_changeProvinceOfResidence_note: "Yes" or "No" — the portal asks whether you are moving to a different province.
_communicationPreference_note: How the portal contacts you, e.g. e-mail or SMS.
